title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 14 at 3:11PM CDT until October 14 at 3:45PM CDT by NWS Norman OK
description: At 311 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Crowell, moving northeast at 25 mph. HAZARD...Two inch hail and 70 mph wind gusts. SOURCE...Radar indicated. IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect considerable tree damage. Wind damage is also likely to mobile homes, roofs, and outbuildings. Locations impacted include... Crowell, Thalia, Margaret, and Rayland.
text:
At 3:11 PM Central Daylight Time, a severe thunderstorm was located near Crowell, moving northeast at 25 miles per hour. Hazard: Two inch hail and 70 miles per hour wind gusts. Source: Radar indicated.

Impact: People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect considerable tree damage.
speech_text:
Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued October 14 at 3:11PM CDT until October 14 at 3:45PM CDT by NWS Norman OK.

At 3:11 PM Central Daylight Time, a severe thunderstorm was located near Crowell, moving northeast at 25 miles per hour. Hazard: Two inch hail and 70 miles per hour wind gusts. Source: Radar indicated.

Impact: People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect considerable tree damage.
thai_text:
เวลา 3:11 PM น. ตอนกลางวัน มีฝนฟ้าคะนองแรงใกล้คราวน์ล ขยับทางตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือเร็ว 25 ไมล์ต่อชั่วโมง์ต่อชั่วโมง. ความเสี่ยง: ฝนฟ้าคะนอง 2 นิ้ว และลมแรง 70 ไมล์ต่อชั่วโมง. แหล่งข่าว: ราดาร์.

ผล กระทบ: คนและสัตว์ในพื้นที่กลางแจ้ง จะได้รับบาดเจ็บ. คาดว่าจะเกิดความเสียหายจากฝนฟ้าคะนอง. คาดว่าจะเสียหายต้นไม้มาก.
